stemMd: What was the initial measured effect of the soft panels?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Sound decayed more quickly within the reading room

options.label: D
options.textMd: All sound from the music classroom stopped

explanationMd: The panels reduced reverberation time, meaning a shorter decay of sound within the room. That improvement did not establish strong isolation from the adjacent classroom.

distractorRationale.d: Sound still entered through the door.
distractorRationale.b: The intervention concerned acoustics, not area.
